scope: Three newly completed native families; source corroboration and disclosed pose limitations.

62820LF-BL.review: Native oblique and side images inspected: wall flange, two swivel stages, two downward paddles and downward outlet are visible. Simplified collars and paddles remain disclosed.
62820LF-BL.source_review: Manufacturer BSP-K-62810LF Rev N page 1 screenshot inspected, including the 62820 lever detail. The dimensioned drawing is the chosen authority for 20.375-inch full projection and 19.25-inch outlet reach.
additional_limitations: ASSUMPTION: use the explicit Rev N drawing rather than the undifferentiated 22-inch reach on the current product page. The 9.25-inch posed height includes a drawing-derived downward handle; it is not the product-page 6.5-inch body-height value.

63221LF-BLLHP.review: Native oblique and side images inspected: two articulated arms, wand, separate hose, base and less-handle spindle are visible. Pose and rigid simplified sections remain limitations.
63221LF-BLLHP.source_review: Current official product page links BSP-K-63121LF-LHP Rev B. Rev B parsed successfully but its screenshot returned cache miss. Manufacturer Rev A, linked by a supplier, was successfully viewed as a PDF screenshot; the relevant 2.4375/6.75/5.875/4.75/21.5-inch and 23-inch hose callouts match Rev B text. Rev A is used only for visual corroboration.
additional_limitations: ASSUMPTION: retain the documented fixed pose at 21.75-inch outer hose height and exactly 23-inch native hose path. It is not a verified manufacturer overall height. The current product page states 19.875 inches, while its linked drawing depicts 21.5 inches and states height varies with arm position. Resolve pose/clearance convention during visual review.

873111-BNX-2.5.review: Native oblique and side images inspected: round wall flange, asymmetric pivot/arm, inclined cylinder and recessed nozzle disk are present. Fixed 45-degree pose and simplified hardware remain disclosed.
873111-BNX-2.5.source_review: Manufacturer BSP-B-873111 Rev A page 1 screenshot inspected. Cylinder/flange diameter 4.75 inches, cylinder length 7.75 inches and full thread-to-head envelope 16 inches are the selected drawing authority.
additional_limitations: ASSUMPTION: use the explicit 873111 title/model drawing even though standard-specification body text names 873110. The 16-inch total includes the assumed 1.5-inch concealed stub; it is not a finished-wall projection.
